meta.format: RGBA8888 (Pillow); an indexed copy made with pngquant sits beside it as <name>.q.png

packing.note: Untrimmed grid: one row per animation, 2 px gutter, frame = sourceSize, pivot at the anchor.

pivot.note: top-centre of the steady foam line (x = centre of the 1536-wide ground, y = top of the foam band). Place it on the ground at (768, placement[v].foamTopYInBackgroundSrcPx), in ground source px, then apply the ground's cover-fit transform

body.note: overlay of the ground: no hitbox. body r = half the ground width (768) so it scales exactly like BeachGround

meta.license: Original art generated for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower with Grok Bot GenerateImage; no third-party packs.

a.note: 40 px above the ground's own shoreline foam row so the steady foam band covers it and the wash slides down onto the sand

b.note: 40 px above the ground's own shoreline foam row so the steady foam band covers it and the wash slides down onto the sand

c.note: 40 px above the ground's own shoreline foam row so the steady foam band covers it and the wash slides down onto the sand

meta.layering: draw after the ground, before the range ring and enemies

provenance.postProcess: _tools/v011_static.py: pinkness matte key, red despill, 4 bands registered on their top foam edge (src tops [95, 319, 555, 805]), scale x1.500, one horizontal row, 2 px gutter

quantizedCopy.metric: PSNR / max error on premultiplied RGBA (colour under alpha 0 ignored)
quantizedCopy.note: same layout as the RGBA original; use either (the RGBA original stays the master)

originalImage.name: beach_surf.png
originalImage.note: RGBA master from the delivery; the repo ships the pngquant copy above (see ../PROVENANCE.json)
